title: AIAS Productivity Dashboard
purpose: Provide a permanent evidence-based command panel for AIAS technological capital, productivity, maturity, governance, departments, risk and delivery flow.
scope: Repository metric aggregation, constitutional status, SDD coverage, documentation, testing, maturity, 45 percent KPI, digital-company capability map, risks, backlog and static interactive dashboard generation.

requirements.title: Evidence aggregation
requirements.statement: The dashboard shall derive metrics from ACE, compliance, documentation, test and roadmap evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Maturity distinction
requirements.statement: The dashboard shall distinguish reference-case capability from audited organizational maturity.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Digital company map
requirements.statement: The dashboard shall expose Constitution, standards, departments, virtual engineers, operating system, university, security, PMO, nervous system, SDD and knowledge system states.
requirements.rationale: Manage AIAS as a digital engineering company.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Sustainable acceleration
requirements.statement: The dashboard shall display classified KPI evidence and flag results below the constitutional 45 percent target.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Permanent panel
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a self-contained interactive HTML panel and machine-readable snapshot.
requirements.rationale: Deliver immediate value without requiring a server.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible release
requirements.statement: The system shall provide CLI, tests, documentation, installer and checksum-protected release evidence.
requirements.rationale: Make the dashboard maintainable and deployable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
